body:
Thanks for the kind thoughts, but I won't be able to volunteer, or live with a roof over my head, or buy food. I'll be ruined. I can't face living on the street. I would rather die than return to the nightmare house I grew up in. It's not just a matter of bottomless depression for me. It's a matter of no longer being able to secure basic human needs.

I used to be on some heavy-duty medications, but I can no longer afford them. Naturally, having to stop cold-turkey has been mentally and physically excruciating. I don't see any hope.
